text.cards: Ginza Annihilated (ESD01-013), any monster cards in hand, Godzilla Emerges (ESD01-014)
text.steps: 1. Activate Ginza Annihilated. 2. Gain rage by discarding monster cards from your hand (8.4); each rage gained destroys 1 of the opponent's rank 6 or lower battle cards. 3. With 2 or more rage, activate Godzilla Emerges: search your deck for a battle card named Godzilla (2023) and play it.
text.result: Several destroys, then a free rank 5 or 7 battle card on a cleared board
text.success: In one turn, Ginza Annihilated destroys at least 1 card and Godzilla Emerges plays a battle card

text.cards: City of Tokyo (ESD01-010), Godzilla Emerges (ESD01-014), Godzilla (2023) battle card (ESD01-012)
text.steps: 1. Have City of Tokyo in play and 2 or more rage. 2. Godzilla Emerges plays ESD01-012 into zone 8 (or ESD01-012 moves there when you play a monster card).
text.result: ESD01-012 in zone 8 at +8000 counter power: +3000 from its own zone 8 bonus, +5000 from City of Tokyo
text.success: ESD01-012 is in zone 8 with both bonuses active

text.cards: Godzilla (2023) rank II monster (ESD01-002), Godzilla (2023) rank III Burst monster (ESD01-006)
text.steps: 1. ESD01-002 invades: search your deck for ESD01-006 and add it to your hand. 2. Next turn, Burst ESD01-006 from rank II: it enters and destroys 1 of the opponent's rank 4 or lower battle cards.
text.result: The searched card becomes an early rank III threat and a destroy
text.success: ESD01-006 found by ESD01-002's search is played with Burst and its [enter] destroys a card. Spans two turns
